_comment: Settings → About card in the Locally app. Fetched at runtime (6h cache), so copy can change WITHOUT shipping a build. Data only — every field renders as escaped text. Unknown fields are ignored; malformed input falls back to the app's built-in defaults. URLs must be https.

plan.label: Local
plan.blurb: Your AI team runs on your own computer, on the ChatGPT or Claude plan you already have. Your data stays with you.
